hypotheses.reasoning: The ingest-api heap filled up steadily: old gen was not reclaimed after full GC (78% at 19:49, then 87% at 19:52). It then crashed with OutOfMemoryError in eventCache.put and was OOMKilled at the 2Gi limit (ingest-api-0 at 19:55, ingest-api-1 at 19:58). That points to the event cache growing without a bound. Each crash or restart left no healthy upstream for a while, so the gateway returned 502s in bursts (lines 141, 168, 184, 205, which show the impact, not the cause). No deploy appears in the window; both restarts log the same v3.26.6. The single schema-validation DLQ message in event-processor (#41) is an unrelated one-off.
v3.26.6 could have introduced the cache leak, but no release event appears in the window.
One message failed schema validation and went to the DLQ. It was isolated and handled cleanly, and isn't tied to the 502s.

verdict.recommendedAction: Short term, raise the ingest-api memory limit or restrict the event cache's size and eviction (for example an LRU or TTL cap) so pods stop being OOMKilled. Take a heap dump to find out why eventCache entries are never evicted, and fix the leak. Check whether v3.26.6 changed how the cache behaves.
